design.decision: Should we push a 6 to a 7? The multiplier also applies on a set, so an overbid hurts.
design.opponent: Shown after bidding when the team reaches 7. Opponents see a contract worth setting.
design.rationale: seed-bid8-mult fires only 24% of rounds. A 7 threshold sits on the margin of most hands, so the decision comes up far more often. It is a deliberate near-duplicate on threshold, a lower rung for common.
design.draftText: +10 contract multiplier when your team bids 7 or more

critic.concerns: Threshold-only near-duplicate of seed-bid8-mult; two commons that differ only by 7 versus 8 will read as clutter.

text: +10 contract multiplier when your team bids 7 or more
